notes.title: Controller support and next goals
notes.content:
Dear players!

We are glad to announce that the game now supports different types of controllers—you can connect PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch controllers to your PC and enjoy playing the available chapters with them. We have put in the effort to ensure direct navigation for EVERYTHING, including:

[list]
[*] Moving Jase directly with the joystick.
[*] Navigating menus, inventory items, spells, and hotspots using the D-Pad or joystick.
[*] Each minigame has its own custom implementation for a better experience.
[*] For those who enjoy moving the cursor and getting the classic Point-and-Click feel—no worries! You can also use the joystick to move the cursor. Your choice!
[/list]
And of course, we have mapped all the keyboard shortcuts, such as the journal, shapeshift, quick save, and game pause, to gamepad buttons. We even included a new feature to skip cutscenes. :)

[b]The controller support is a crucial milestone for us and will be used on consoles later.[/b]

The game will recognize which controller is connected and will display a dedicated mapping scheme that can be accessed at any time during gameplay. Here’s the control scheme for Xbox:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/1db68953cd13e059409506c2751734dc57471e21.png[/img]

[b]Why are we focusing on other platforms instead of developing Chapter 2?[/b]

In our last update, we mentioned that the game is available on mobile devices, and now we are targeting consoles. As an indie studio working part-time with a tight budget, Chapter 2 is taking more time than we would like. We don't want to compromise by shipping a low-quality product just to say we completed it.
We want to continue the game with the same quality of humor, graphics, puzzles, and everything we've put our effort into so far. To speed up the process, we MUST reach a larger audience, which will eventually help increase our budget. Ultimately, this will assist us in finishing Chapter 2—a milestone we are eager to achieve—as well as the rest of the chapters.

As you can see, we are still working on the game, and we will ship more chapters one way or another. This game will be completed as promised. I hope you understand our position. If not, I can only focus on making the game with passion ♥️🧙‍♂️

Yakir

notes.title: Porting to Android and iOS and More!
notes.content:
[b]Porting and Publishing to Android and iOS[/b]

We now support touch screens! We have completed the porting process for both Android and iOS. Both the prologue and Chapter 1 are fully playable on mobile devices and tablets. This is our first time porting a game, and we're really excited about it. We hope you are too! Moreover, the game has also been self-published on both Google Play and the App Store. We can't wait to see you playing the game on iPhones, iPads, and various Android devices as well. Here's the links:

[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/plot-of-the-druid-chapter-1/id6532588436]App Store link
[/url][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Adventure4Life.PlotOfTheDruid]Google Play link[/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/5e9176ad903aaa06587c58bfd25ed74116aeaca9.png[/img]

[b]More Resolution Support[/b]

While the native resolution is Full HD (1080p), we have adjusted the game to support a wider range of resolutions, such as HD (720p), Quad HD, Wide Quad HD (1440p), and even 4K UHD! You can also play the game in different aspect ratios other than 16:9 (with black bars for the missing areas), such as 16:10, 4:3, 3:2, 18:9, 20:9, 21:9, and many more.

[b]Achievements[/b]

Both the prologue and Chapter 1 now have Steam achievements. Go get them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/699db806d481508c42ba1db3eaa4df767df5b991.png[/img]

[b]Languages[/b]

Russian subtitles have been added, and Chinese is coming next!

[b]Optimization[/b]
We have managed to significantly reduce the build size from 3.6 GB to 1.7 GB without compromising the end result.

[b]Chapter 2
[/b]
Yes, we are working hard on this chapter. We expect it to be released in 6-8 months, so we appreciate your patience. We are a small team doing our best to create a great game. I can tell you that this chapter is going to be a lot of fun; we have already crafted an enjoyable story and introduced new mechanics. We've even built our own visual effects tool to make the game more appealing. Here are some work-in-progress sneak peeks:

[previewyoutube=a3A0iTUvt6Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=Ea7Tdh9w34M;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Consoles
[/b]
We have submitted applications to port and publish the game on Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch, and we hope to share good news soon.

Cheers!

Yakir

notes.title: Estimated release date annoucement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/5f2d2cfc5a2ed9be5eb9cc78db3bd0500edf2ef3.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that the estimated release date of “Plot of the Druid” is - [b]Q1 2022[/b]

Plot of the Druid is a story-driven point and click adventure packed with dry, sarcastic British wit
that’s reminiscent of Simon the Sorcerer, Discworld, and Harry Potter. 
The game is filled to the brim with challenging puzzles and a graphical style that uses high-definition hand-painted drawings which also capture the feel of old-school adventure games. Embark on a journey of exploration in a humorous, shameless fantasy world.

Will you be able to attain the incredible power of a master druid? Only one way to find out!

[previewyoutube=dJcjl7Ow9zI;full][/previewyoutube]
